findings.title: No-op string replace in cancel test
findings.why: `d(1).replace('00:00', '00:00')` replaces a string with itself, so it does nothing and just confuses the reader. Use `d(1)`. The test is also named as if it only checks a refund before the start, but this assertion checks the no-refund case at the start instant.

findings.title: AvailabilityQuery docs say midnight but any hour is accepted
findings.why: The doc comments for `start` and `end` say 'midnight UTC'. `availability()` uses `parseHourUtc`, which accepts any on-the-hour time. The code and the docs disagree, so either the comments or the validation should change.
